verdict.rationale: Anrok's API supports mapping catalog products to tax categories via product IDs and many-to-1 mappings (each unique tax category needs only one product ID), and jurisdiction-aware tax calculation/address resolution is documented. However, there's no explicit documentation showing the specific vendor tax category taxonomy (SaaS, digital goods, services, physical products) or a UI/API walkthrough of assigning each of those category types across jurisdictions. missing for 10: explicit list/definition of tax category taxonomy (SaaS vs digital goods vs services vs physical goods), concrete UI/API example mapping catalog items to these categories, independent corroboration of category-based jurisdictional taxation accuracy.
